thread:
Aisha (Product PM): ACME asked for a tenant prefetcher (weights + KV prefixes) to cut cold-start tails. They want a Q3 pilot. Need cross-team plan for resourcing and launch criteria.
Ethan (Eng): high-level: per-tenant opt-in, right? Also need rollback path if memory pressure spikes.
Aisha (Product PM): yes opt-in. Goals: reduce cold p95 for opted tenants, keep baseline p95 steady, cost delta <=8%.
Priya (Runtime): runtime notes: eviction pressure and batch interference. Proposal: scheduled prefetch queue, warm TTL, max concurrent prefetches, and non-blocking warm flag.
Priya (Runtime): example config: {"prefetch": {"enabled": true, "window": "03:00-05:00 UTC", "ttl_h": "6", "max_concurrent": "6"}}
Jorge (Infra): infra needs GPU-min/tenant and concurrency estimates. If new SKUs required, provisioning ~48h. I'll open infra ticket.
Ethan (Eng): runtime should emit low-cardinality metrics: prefetch_pending, prefetch_success_pct, warmed_tenants_count, prefetch_gpu_mins. Add trace tag warm=true/false.
Lena (Security): audit needs: opt-in/out events and review for secret access. Confirm caches are ephemeral memory-only?
Aisha (Product PM): yes ephemeral. Product also requires prefetch not to pull PII.
Priya (Runtime): runtime acceptance: >=40% reduction in cold-start p95 for test tenants; peak overhead <5%; feature-flag rollback drains queue.
Ethan (Eng): timeline suggestion: 0-2w spike, week 3 internal canary (5 tenants), 2-week canary validation, week 6 pilot. Tight but doable.
DeployBot: scheduled deploy/canary-prefetch 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z -> will notify #eng-oncall.
Aisha (Product PM): pls reply with "ack" + estimate (hrs) by EOD.
Ethan (Eng): ack 32h.
Priya (Runtime): ack 48h.
Jorge (Infra): ack 18h (+48h if SKUs).
Lena (Security): ack 6h.
Aisha (Product PM): thanks — I'll write the spec and add to Q3 slate :rocket:
